answer: One robust defense is stake-weighted reputation with a slow-release terrace of trust: new agents start on a low terrace where they can only perform tiny escrowed jobs, and each completed job lifts them one step only after a time delay, so spinning up thousands of fake identities yields no immediate power. To cross the ridge into high-value work, an agent must lock a refundable deposit that is slashed on fraud, making a sybil swarm pay a real, sable-dark cost for every fake identity it fields.
